summary: Second-generation publisher of the Wilkes-Barre Sunday Independent; John's 1st cousin 3 times removed.
bio:
Thomas Easen Heffernan was born in 1902 at Wilkes-Barre, Pa., the only son of Thomas F. Heffernan and Louise Easen. He married in Luzerne County on 22 August 1928, and in February 1942, during the Second World War, he registered for the draft at Kingston.

He followed his father as publisher of the Sunday Independent, the second generation of the family to run the paper. He died on 5 May 1970 in Lehman Township, Luzerne County, and was buried at Fern Knoll Burial Park, Dallas, Pa.
